qa_pair.question: Audit this Dockerfile — it has no USER directive so it runs as root: `FROM ubuntu:22.04\nRUN apt-get update\nCMD ["./server"]`.
qa_pair.answer: altais_audit_dockerfile returns a `dockerfile-runs-as-root` finding at high severity because no non-root USER is set.

qa_pair.question: Audit this Dockerfile that pins a mutable tag: `FROM node:latest\nCOPY . .\nCMD ["node", "index.js"]`.
qa_pair.answer: altais_audit_dockerfile reports a finding for the mutable `latest` base image tag and a finding for the whole-context `COPY .`.

qa_pair.question: Audit this Dockerfile for a remote script piped into a shell: `RUN curl -sSL https://example.com/install.sh | bash`.
qa_pair.answer: altais_audit_dockerfile reports a finding that a remote script is fetched and piped directly into a shell, an unverified supply-chain risk.

qa_pair.question: Audit this Dockerfile for credentials baked into the image: `ARG AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=wJalrXUtnFEMI/K7MDENG/bPxRfiCYEXAMPLEKEY`.
qa_pair.answer: altais_audit_dockerfile reports a finding that a credential is baked into an ENV/ARG instruction.

qa_pair.question: Audit this Dockerfile for a world-writable chmod: `RUN chmod 777 /app/data`.
qa_pair.answer: altais_audit_dockerfile reports a finding for the world-writable `chmod 777` instruction.

qa_pair.question:
Audit a well-formed Dockerfile that pins a digest, sets a non-root user, and adds a HEALTHCHECK: `FROM node:20-alpine@sha256:abc123
USER node
HEALTHCHECK CMD curl -f http://localhost/health
CMD ["node","app.js"]`.
qa_pair.answer: altais_audit_dockerfile returns no runs-as-root, no mutable-tag, and no missing-HEALTHCHECK findings; the file follows the audited best practices.

Audit this Docker Compose service for privileged mode: `services:
 app:
 image: myapp:1.0
 privileged: true`.
qa_pair.answer: altais_audit_compose reports a finding that the service runs in privileged mode.

qa_pair.question: Audit this Compose file for a mounted Docker socket: `volumes:\n - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock`.
qa_pair.answer: altais_audit_compose reports a finding that the Docker socket is mounted into the container, which grants host-level control.
